source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 33 (PDF 247-261), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 33 (Water) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Give two ways in which water is important for humans and two ways it is important in nature.
(Insaanon ke liye pani ki ahmiyat ke do tareeqe aur qudrat mein is ki ahmiyat ke do tareeqe bataayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Insaan: pani hydration (jism mein pani ki maujoodgi) aur safai se hamein zinda aur sehatmand rakhta hai aur jism se zehreele maadde nikalta hai.
Qudrat: pani zameen ko shakal deta hai, climate mein tawazun rakhta hai aur zer-e-zameen ke zakhire bharta hai.

book_ref.quote: It keeps humans alive and healthy through hydration and hygiene

blocks.prompt:
2 Why are the properties of water central to the study of water pollution?
(Water pollution ke mutaale mein pani ki khususiyaat markazi kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pani ka molecule (H₂O) permanent dipole hai. Yeh polarity pani ko munfarid khususiyaat (thermal stability, solvent ki salahiyat, amphoteric nature, dissolved oxygen, redox rawayya) deti hai jo aabi zakhiron mein pollution ki noiyat aur hadd tay karti hain.

book_ref.quote: This polarity renders water unique properties essential for life and the environment.

blocks.prompt:
3 What makes large bodies of water thermally stable?
(Bare aabi zakhire thermally stable kyun hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: H₂O ki polarity se molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds bante hain. Hydrogen bonding pani ko zyada specific heat capacity aur zyada heat of vaporisation deti hai, is liye bare aabi zakhire temperature ki tez tabdeeli ka muqabla karte hain.

book_ref.quote: large bodies of water are thermally stable, resisting rapid temperature changes

blocks.prompt:
4 Why is water a good solvent for ionic substances such as nitrates and phosphates?
(Pani nitrates aur phosphates jaise ionic substances ka achha solvent kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polarity ki wajah se pani ke molecules ions (metallic ions, NO₃⁻, PO₄³⁻) ko gher lete hain aur yun bohat se ionic substances hal ho jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: such as metallic ions, nitrates (NO₃⁻) and phosphates (PO₄³⁻), by surrounding the ions

blocks.prompt:
5 How does the solvent ability of water help pesticides and herbicides spread in the environment?
(Pani ki solvent salahiyat pesticides aur herbicides ko mahol mein phailne mein kaise madad deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pani polar organic compounds ko hal kar leta hai, is liye bohat se pesticides aur herbicides aasani se water cycle mein daakhil ho kar tik jaate hain aur jaandaron mein jama (bioaccumulation) hote hain.

book_ref.quote: where they can persist and undergo bioaccumulation

blocks.prompt:
6 What is meant by the amphoteric nature of water? Why is it important for water quality?
(Pani ki amphoteric nature se kya muraad hai? Yeh pani ke miyaar ke liye kyun aham hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pani acid aur base dono ki tarah kaam kar sakta hai. Is ki self-ionisation (25°C par Kw = 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁴) pH scale ki bunyaad hai; zyada tar aabi jaandar pH ki tabdeeli ke liye bohat hassas hain.

book_ref.quote: provides the baseline for the pH scale

blocks.prompt:
7 How does acid rain change the chemistry of a lake?
(Acid rain jheel ki chemistry ko kaise badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acid rain SO₂ aur NOₓ ke hal hone se banti hai. Yeh hydronium ions (H₃O⁺) ki concentration barha kar pH kam karti hai, jis ke liye zyada tar aabi zindagi bohat hassas hai.

book_ref.quote: Most of the aquatic life is highly sensitive to pH fluctuations.

blocks.prompt:
8 Define dissolved oxygen (DO). What do high and low DO levels indicate?
(Dissolved oxygen (DO) ki definition likhein. Zyada aur kam DO kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: DO pani mein woh oxygen hai jo aabi jaandaron ke saans lene ke liye dastiyab ho. Zyada DO aam tor par saaf pani, aur kam DO pollution ya organic maadde ki zyada decomposition ki nishani hai.

book_ref.quote: Dissolved oxygen (DO) is a key indicator of water quality

blocks.prompt:
9 Define Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD). Under what conditions is it usually measured?
(Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD) ki definition likhein. Yeh aam tor par kin halaat mein naapi jaati hai?)
blocks.explanation: BOD woh oxygen hai jo microorganisms ko pani ka organic maadda torne ke liye aik muqarrara arse mein chahiye. Yeh aam tor par 20°C par paanch din mein naapi jaati hai.

book_ref.quote: is the amount of oxygen required by microorganisms to break down organic matter

blocks.prompt:
10 Define Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD) and name two oxidising agents used for it.
(Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD) ki definition likhein aur is mein istemal hone wale do oxidising agents ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: COD woh oxygen hai jo oxidising agents ke zariye pani ke organic aur inorganic substances ko chemically oxidise karne mein lage. Misaalein: KMnO₄ aur K₂Cr₂O₇.

book_ref.quote: is the amount of oxygen required to chemically oxidise organic and inorganic substances

blocks.prompt:
11 What do high COD values indicate about a water sample?
(Zyada COD values pani ke sample ke baare mein kya batati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada COD oxidise hone wale chemical pollutants ki zyada concentration dikhata hai, yani pani ka miyaar kharab hai aur industrial ya gharelu waste ki aaloodgi mumkin hai. COD se kul pollution load ka andaza hota hai.

book_ref.quote: suggesting poor water quality and potential contamination from industrial or domestic waste

blocks.prompt:
12 Compare treated sewage and raw sewage using the DO and BOD ranges of Table 33.1.
(Table 33.1 ki DO aur BOD ranges se treated sewage aur raw sewage ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Treated sewage mein ab bhi kuch dissolved oxygen hai aur organic load raw sewage se bohat kam hai:

book_ref.quote: Table 33.1 Typical ranges of DO, BOD, and COD in water

rows: DO 2 – 4 mg/L
DO < 1 mg/L
BOD 10 – 30 mg/L
BOD 100 – 400 mg/L
COD 30 – 100 mg/L
COD 200 – 1000 mg/L

blocks.prompt:
13 Compare well-oxygenated water and oxygen-depleted (stagnant) water in terms of redox conditions.
(Achhi oxygen wale pani aur oxygen ki kami wale (khade) pani ka redox halaat ke lihaz se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Redox potential pani ki oxidising ya reducing tabiyat ka paimana hai:

book_ref.quote: However, in polluted or stagnant water, where oxygen is depleted, the environment becomes reducing.

rows: Oxidising mahol
Reducing mahol (oxygen khatam)
Species sab se oxidised shakal mein, jaise SO₄²⁻ aur CO₂
Zehreele maadde bante hain, jaise H₂S aur NH₃

blocks.prompt:
14 Define point-source pollution and give one example.
(Point-source pollution ki definition likhein aur aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Point-source pollution woh aaloodgi hai jo aabi zakhire mein aik akeli, alag aur pehchani ja sakne wali jagah se aaye. Misaal: factory jo khaas wastewater pipe se lead ya mercury salts seedha darya mein daale.

book_ref.quote: Point-source pollution is the contamination that enters a water body

blocks.prompt:
15 Compare point-source and non-point source pollution in terms of origin, spread and examples.
(Point-source aur non-point source pollution ka source, phailao aur misaalon ke lihaz se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono qismon ka muqabla:

book_ref.quote: Unlike point sources, NPS pollution is heavily dependent on weather events like heavy storms.

rows: Aik akeli, pehchani ja sakne wali jagah se aati hai
Phaili hui; barish ya pighalti barf ke bahao se aati hai
Nikaas ke qareeb jama (pollution plume)
Bohat wasee ilaqe mein phaili hui
Toofani barish par munhasir nahi
Toofani barish jaise mausami waqiaat par bohat munhasir
Misaal: factory ka wastewater pipe; leak hota storage tank
Misaal: kheton se beh kar aaya fertilizer; roads ka stormwater

blocks.prompt:
16 Give one agricultural example of non-point source pollution.
(Non-point source pollution ki aik zarai misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Barish ka hazaron hectare kheton se zaid ammonium nitrate (NH₄NO₃), fertilizers aur pesticides ko darya ke nizam mein baha le jaana.

book_ref.quote: excess ammonium nitrate (NH₄NO₃), fertilizers, and pesticides from thousands of hectares of farmland

blocks.prompt:
17 What is microbiological pollution? Name its two main sources.
(Microbiological pollution kya hai? Is ke do bare sources ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Microbiological pollution nuqsan deh microorganisms (bacteria, viruses, protozoa, parasites) se pani ki aaloodgi hai. Sources: bina saaf kiya ya adhoora saaf sewage aur haiwanon ka fuzla (hospital waste aur kheton ka bahao bhi).

book_ref.quote: This type of pollution typically results from the discharge of untreated or inadequately treated sewage

blocks.prompt:
18 Name three pathogens and three water-borne diseases associated with microbiologically polluted water.
(Microbiologically aaluda pani se mutaliq teen pathogens aur teen water-borne bimariyon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Pathogens: Escherichia coli, Salmonella aur Giardia.
Water-borne bimariyan: cholera, typhoid aur dysentery (hepatitis A bhi).

book_ref.quote: Microorganisms in water, such as bacteria, viruses, and protozoa are the major cause of water-borne diseases.

blocks.prompt:
19 Name four toxic heavy metals that pollute water and three routes by which they enter it.
(Pani ko aaluda karne wali chaar zehreeli heavy metals aur un ke daakhil hone ke teen raaste bataayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Heavy metals: mercury, lead, arsenic aur cadmium.
Raaste: industrial discharge, mining aur waste ko ghalat tareeqe se phenkna.

book_ref.quote: This type of pollution often includes toxic heavy metals like mercury, lead, arsenic, and cadmium

blocks.prompt:
20 How is methylmercury formed in water and why is it more dangerous than inorganic mercury?
(Pani mein methylmercury kaise banta hai aur yeh inorganic mercury se zyada khatarnak kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aabi sediments mein bacteria inorganic mercury ko methylmercury, [CH₃Hg]⁺, mein badalte hain. Yeh charbi mein bohat hal hota hai, is liye membranes aur blood-brain barrier aasani se paar karke biomagnification karta hai.

book_ref.quote: In aquatic sediments, bacteria convert inorganic mercury into methylmercury

blocks.prompt:
21 Give the major sources of lead in water.
(Pani mein lead ke bare sources bataayein.)
blocks.explanation: Leaded petrol (ab duniya bhar mein paabandi), purani plumbing (lead pipes), lead-acid batteries aur paints. Pb²⁺ ions aksar pipes ke corrosion se pani mein aate hain.

book_ref.quote: The major sources of lead are leaded petrol

blocks.prompt:
22 State two health effects of lead.
(Lead ke sehat par do asraat bataayein.)
blocks.explanation: Lead haemoglobin ki tayyari mein rukawat daal kar anaemia (khoon ki kami) karta hai. Bachon mein yeh jama hone wala zehar hai jo na theek hone wala aasaabi nuqsan aur nashonuma mein der paida karta hai.

book_ref.quote: In children, it acts as a cumulative poison

blocks.prompt:
23 What is Itai-itai disease? Name one source of cadmium in water.
(Itai-itai bimari kya hai? Pani mein cadmium ka aik source bataayein.)
blocks.explanation: Itai-itai bimari cadmium ke lambe arse tak khaane se hoti hai: Cd haddiyon mein calcium ki jagah le kar unhein bohat bhurbhura kar deta hai; gurdon ko bhi shadeed nuqsan deta hai. Source: metal plating (plastic stabilisers, phosphate fertilizer ki milawat bhi).

book_ref.quote: Long-term ingestion of cadmium (Cd) leads to

blocks.prompt:
24 Why are heavy metals particularly dangerous to living organisms?
(Heavy metals jaandaron ke liye khaas tor par khatarnak kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Heavy metals ke atomic weights aur densities zyada hain aur yeh non-biodegradable hain. Is liye yeh jaandaron ke tissues aur food chain mein jama hoti hain aur aabi zindagi aur insaanon ke liye lambe arse ka khatra hain.

book_ref.quote: Due to their non-biodegradable nature, they tend to accumulate in the tissues of living organisms

blocks.prompt:
25 A drinking-water sample contains 0.012 mg/L mercury and 0.015 mg/L chromium. Using Table 33.2, state whether each is within the WHO limit.
(Peene ke pani ke sample mein mercury 0.012 mg/L aur chromium 0.015 mg/L hai. Table 33.2 se bataayein ke kya har aik WHO hadd ke andar hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Mercury: WHO hadd 0.006 mg/L; 0.012 / 0.006 = 2, yani mercury hadd ka do guna hai (ghair mehfooz).
Chromium: WHO hadd 0.05 mg/L; 0.015 < 0.05, is liye chromium hadd ke andar hai.

book_ref.quote: The limiting concentrations (mg/L) of some heavy metals are provided in Table 33.2.

blocks.prompt:
26 What was the Minamata Disaster?
(Minamata haadsa kya tha?)
blocks.explanation: 1950s mein Minamata, Japan mein industrial pollution ka shadeed waqia. Pani mein methylmercury chhorne se mercury ka zehar phaila: hazaron logon ko aasaabi nuqsan, paidaishi naqais, amwaat aur mahooliyati tabahi.

book_ref.quote: affecting thousands of people with neurological damage and causing birth defects

blocks.prompt:
27 Why do pesticides like DDT build up in fish and birds although DDT is insoluble in water?
(DDT pani mein na hal hone ke bawajood machhliyon aur parindon mein kyun jama hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: DDT non-polar hai, is liye pani mein hal nahi hota magar machhliyon aur parindon ke charbi wale tissues mein bohat hal hota hai. Yeh persistent organic pollutant (POP) hai, is liye in tissues mein tikta aur jama hota rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Pesticides and Herbicides such as DDT and Glyphosate are another hazardous material

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ne DDT aur glyphosate dono ko non-polar likha hai; Book correction ke mutabiq yeh sirf DDT par sach hai. Glyphosate polar hai aur pani mein khoob hal hota hai. Is liye yahan sirf DDT ki baat ki gayi hai.

blocks.prompt:
28 What are endocrine disruptors? Give one effect on wildlife and one on humans.
(Endocrine disruptors kya hain? Jangli haiwanon aur insaanon par aik aik asar bataayein.)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se pesticides endocrine disruptors hain: yeh estrogen jaise qudrati hormones ki tarah kaam karte hain. Jangli haiwan: nasal-kashi ki nakami, jaise parindon ke andon ke chhilke patle hona. Insaan: hormonal cancers se taaluq.

book_ref.quote: This can lead to the reproductive failure in wildlife

blocks.prompt:
29 What are PCBs? How do they reach water and what are their health effects?
(PCBs kya hain? Yeh pani tak kaise pohanchte hain aur sehat par kya asar karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: PCBs (polychlorinated biphenyls) transformers mein coolant ke tor par istemal hue; khatarnak waste ki jaghon se pani mein leak hote hain. Yeh mumkina carcinogens hain, immune system dabate hain aur chloracne jaisi jild ki bimariyan karte hain.

book_ref.quote: PCBs are classified as probable human carcinogens.

blocks.prompt:
30 Define eutrophication and give its three usual sources.
(Eutrophication ki definition likhein aur is ke teen aam sources bataayein.)
blocks.explanation: Eutrophication (nutrient pollution) tab hoti hai jab zyada nutrients, khaas kar nitrogen aur phosphorus, aabi zakhiron mein aa jaayein. Aam sources: kheton ka bahao, wastewater ka ikhraj aur stormwater.

book_ref.quote: Nutrient pollution, also known as eutrophication

blocks.prompt:
31 How do algal blooms create dead zones in a water body?
(Algal blooms aabi zakhire mein dead zones kaise banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Algal blooms paani ke andar ke paudon tak dhoop nahi pohanchne dete. Jab algae mar kar galti hai to bohat si oxygen kha jaati hai aur hypoxic 'dead zones' bante hain jahan aabi zindagi nahi bach sakti.

book_ref.quote: These blooms can block sunlight from reaching underwater plants.

blocks.prompt:
32 What is Blue Baby Syndrome?
(Blue Baby Syndrome kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Blue Baby Syndrome (methaemoglobinaemia) un bachon ko hota hai jo zyada nitrate wala pani peete hain: nitrates khoon ki oxygen le jaane ki salahiyat kam kar dete hain.

book_ref.quote: where nitrates reduce the blood's capacity to carry oxygen

blocks.prompt:
33 How does oil pollution harm fish, marine mammals and coastal habitats?
(Tel ki aaloodgi machhliyon, samandari mammals aur saahili maskanon ko kaise nuqsan deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Samandari mammals safai karte hue zehreela tel nigal lete hain; machhliyon ko hydrocarbons ke asar se lambe arse ke sehat ke masail hote hain. Tel mangroves, coral reefs aur saahilon jaise maskanon ko bhi nuqsan deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Oil pollution also damages coastal habitats such as mangroves, coral reefs, and beaches.

blocks.prompt:
34 State two ways in which plastic waste harms marine animals.
(Plastic waste samandari jaandaron ko kin do tareeqon se nuqsan deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Samandari jaandar plastic ko khuraak samajh kar nigal lete hain, jis se dam ghutna ya andaruni zakhm hota hai jo jaan lewa ho sakta hai. Purane jaal aur malbe mein phans kar kachhuye, dolphins aur parinde zakhmi ya halaak hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Marine animals often mistake plastic for food

blocks.prompt:
35 What are the effects of solid waste pollution on waterways?
(Thos waste ki aaloodgi ka aabi raaston par kya asar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thos waste aabi raaston ko band karta hai, aabi maskanon mein khalal daalta hai aur pani ka miyaar kam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Solid waste pollution also clogs waterways

blocks.text: 33.4 Water Pollution due to Human Activities

blocks.prompt:
36 Why is water pollution from human activities increasing across the globe?
(Insani sargarmiyon se water pollution duniya bhar mein kyun barh rahi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aabadi aur industries barhne se zyada waste aur pollutants aabi zakhiron mein aate hain. Waste ka ghalat intezam aur mahooliyati qawaneen ki kami aaloodgi ko daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron tak pohanchati hai.

book_ref.quote: As populations grow and industries expand, more waste and pollutants are introduced into water bodies.

blocks.prompt:
37 Name four industries that commonly release water pollution.
(Chaar industries ke naam likhein jo aam tor par water pollution chhorti hain.)
blocks.explanation: Oil refineries, chemical plants, automobile industry aur tanneries (fertilizer industries bhi).

book_ref.quote: The common industries that release pollution, are oil refineries

blocks.prompt:
38 How do agricultural activities pollute both surface water and groundwater?
(Zarai sargarmiyan satahi aur zer-e-zameen dono pani ko kaise aaluda karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Fertilizers, pesticides aur herbicides beh kar qareebi aabi zakhiron mein jaate hain; ghalat aabpashi se mitti kat kar daryaon mein jaati hai; kheton ki nikaasi pollutants ko satahi aur zer-e-zameen dono pani mein le jaati hai.

book_ref.quote: drainage from farmlands carries pollutants that contaminate both surface and groundwater sources

blocks.prompt:
39 How does domestic and municipal waste pollute water?
(Gharelu aur municipal waste pani ko kaise aaluda karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Shehron ka bina saaf ya kam saaf sewage aur thos waste daryaon mein jaa kar nuqsan deh bacteria aur viruses laata hai; detergents, tel aur chemicals naaliyon mein jaate hain; naliyon ke qareeb phenka plastic rukawat aur lambi aaloodgi paida karta hai.

book_ref.quote: introducing harmful bacteria and viruses

blocks.prompt:
40 How do deforestation and urban development add to water pollution?
(Jangalat ki katai aur shehri taraqqi water pollution mein kaise izafa karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Darakht katne se mitti dheeli ho kar kat jaati hai aur daryaon mein sediment barhta hai jo aabi raaste band karta, maskanon ko nuqsan deta aur miyaar kam karta hai. Tameerat bahao ke pani mein pollutants aur malba daalti hai.

book_ref.quote: This sediment can clog waterways, harm aquatic habitats, and reduce water quality.

blocks.prompt:
41 How can recreational activities pollute lakes and rivers?
(Tafreehi sargarmiyan jheelon aur daryaon ko kaise aaluda kar sakti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kashtiyan tel, fuel aur chemicals pani mein chhorti hain jo aabi zindagi ko nuqsan dete hain; sayyah plastic, khaane ke rapper aur doosra kachra phenkte hain.

book_ref.quote: can contribute to water pollution if not properly managed

blocks.prompt:
42 Name three ways in which marine transport pollutes water.
(Samandari transport pani ko aaluda karne ke teen tareeqe bataayein.)
blocks.explanation: Achanak tel ka girna; jahazon se wastewater aur sewage ka ikhraj; hull ki safai aur rang jaisi maamool ki dekh bhaal jo zehreele maadde chhorti hai.

book_ref.quote: Accidental oil spills, wastewater and sewage from vessels

blocks.text: 33.5 Effect of Water Pollution on the Environment

blocks.prompt:
43 List four common environmental impacts of water pollution.
(Water pollution ke chaar aam mahooliyati asraat ki fehrist dein.)
blocks.explanation: Biodiversity ka nuqsan, maskanon ki tabahi, food chains mein khalal aur pani ke miyaar mein kami.

book_ref.quote: Pollutants can alter the physical and chemical properties of water

blocks.prompt:
44 How does water pollution reduce biodiversity?
(Water pollution biodiversity (hayati tanawwo) ko kaise kam karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aaluda pani oxygen kam karta (hypoxia), coral reefs ko nuqsan deta aur food chains bigaarta hai; zehreele chemicals jaandar maarte hain; nasal-kashi, khuraak aur hijrat mein khalal se aabadi ghatti aur hassas species khatam hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: It damages coral reefs and disrupts food chains.

blocks.prompt:
45 Compare bioaccumulation and biomagnification.
(Bioaccumulation aur biomagnification ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mercury, lead aur pesticides jaise zehar ke jama hone se mutaliq hain:

book_ref.quote: Bioaccumulation and biomagnification are serious adverse effects of water pollution

rows: Zehar waqt ke saath aik jaandar ke jism mein jama hota hai
Zehar food chain mein oopar jaate hue zyada concentrated hota hai
Aik hi jaandar ke andar (jaise aabi jaanwar)
Khuraak ke mukhtalif darjon mein
Sab se oopar ke shikari, insaan samet, sab se zyada miqdaar paate hain

blocks.prompt:
46 How does polluted water damage soil and plants?
(Aaluda pani mitti aur paudon ko kaise nuqsan deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Heavy metals, industrial waste aur zyada nutrients mitti mein jazb ho kar us ki banawat aur zarkhezi badalte aur microbial sargarmi bigaarte hain. Paudon ki barhotri rukti, patton ka rang badalta aur woh mar bhi sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: Contaminants like heavy metals, industrial waste, and excessive nutrients seep into the soil

blocks.prompt:
47 Why is sewage or agricultural runoff entering a lake linked to climate change?
(Jheel mein sewage ya kheton ka bahao aana climate change se kyun juraa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aisa waste algae aur doosre jaandaron ki barhotri tez karta hai. Jab yeh oxygen ki kami (anaerobic) mein mar kar galte hain to methane, aik taqatwar greenhouse gas, nikalti hai jo global warming barhati hai.

book_ref.quote: The excess methane contributes to climate change and worsens global warming.

blocks.prompt:
48 Name the three levels of wastewater treatment and the purpose of each.
(Wastewater treatment ke teen darjon ke naam aur har aik ka maqsad likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Primary treatment: physical malba nikalna.
Secondary treatment: biological processing.
Tertiary treatment: chemical safai.

book_ref.quote: These techniques are used at different levels of water treatment

blocks.prompt:
49 Compare screening and sedimentation in water treatment.
(Water treatment mein screening aur sedimentation ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono treatment ke pehle marhale ka hissa hain:

book_ref.quote: This is followed by sedimentation, where water is held in large tanks

rows: Pani metal screens (jaaliyon) se guzara jaata hai
Pani bare tankon mein rakha jaata hai
Bare na hal hone wale zarre nikalte hain
Latke thos zarre tah mein baith jaate hain
Pehle kiya jaata hai
Screening ke baad; gravity se kaam karta hai

blocks.prompt:
50 What is the role of coagulation and flocculation? Name the coagulant used.
(Coagulation aur flocculation ka kya kirdar hai? Istemal hone wale coagulant ka naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh bareek colloidal zarron ka baithna tez karte hain aur ghule contaminants (heavy metals, phosphates) ko na hal hone wali shakal mein precipitate karte hain. Coagulant aluminium sulphate, Al₂(SO₄)₃, hai.

book_ref.quote: It involves the precipitation of dissolved contaminants

blocks.prompt:
51 How does a sand-and-gravel filter purify water? What is used for more advanced purification?
(Ret aur bajri ka filter pani kaise saaf karta hai? Mazeed behtar safai ke liye kya istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Filtration mechanical amal hai: pani darja-ba-darja ret aur bajri se guzarta hai; ret physical rukawat ban kar bareek zarre aur kuch microorganisms daanon ke darmiyan khali jagah mein rok leti hai. Behtar safai ke liye activated carbon istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The sand acts as a physical barrier, trapping particles within the pores between grains.

blocks.prompt:
52 How does chlorination disinfect water?
(Chlorination pani ko jaraseem se paak kaise karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pani mein chlorine gas ya sodium hypochlorite (NaOCl) daalne se hypochlorous acid (HOCl) banta hai jo bacteria aur viruses ki cell walls mein ghus kar un ke kaam bigaar deta hai.

book_ref.quote: which penetrates the cell walls of bacteria and viruses, disrupting their cell functions

blocks.prompt:
53 What is hard water? How does an ion-exchange column soften it?
(Hard water kya hai? Ion-exchange column ise naram kaise karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hard water mein Ca²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ ions zyada hote hain jo industrial processes aur saabun ki karkardagi bigaarte hain. Ion-exchange column mein yeh ions Na⁺ ya H⁺ ions se badal diye jaate hain.

blocks.text: 33.7 Protection and Conservation of Water Resources

blocks.prompt:
54 Give four strategies for controlling water pollution.
(Water pollution control ki chaar strategies bataayein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Industries aur municipalities ke liye sakht discharge standards. (2) Sewage treatment plants behtar karna aur jadeed technology (membrane filtration, bioreactors) wale Effluent Treatment Plants lagana. (3) Pani ke miyaar ki musalsal nigrani. (4) Aaluda karne walon par sakht jurmaane aur saaf tareeqon par incentives (targheeb).

book_ref.quote: Imposing strict discharge standards for industries and municipalities

blocks.prompt:
55 Why are penalties and incentives used together in pollution control?
(Pollution control mein jurmaane aur incentives saath saath kyun istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sakht jurmaane mahooliyati khilaf warzi ko rokte hain, jab ke saaf tareeqon par incentives industries aur logon ko paidaar, pollution se paak kaam apnane par aamada karte hain.

book_ref.quote: This approach discourages environmental violations

blocks.prompt:
56 What is greywater? How does reusing it help?
(Greywater kya hai? Is ka dobara istemal kaise faida deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Greywater ghar ka istemal shuda pani hai (kapre, bartan, nahana). Ise bagbani, toilet flush aur industrial cooling mein dobara lagane se meetha pani bachta aur sewage treatment par bojh kam hota hai.

book_ref.quote: reduces the burden on sewage treatment systems

blocks.prompt:
57 Why is regular repair of water supply infrastructure a water-conservation measure?
(Pani ki supply ke nizam ki baqaida marammat pani bachane ka tareeqa kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Baqaida marammat aur dekh bhaal leaks aur pani ka zayaa kam karti hai, jis se pani behtar tareeqe se pohanchta aur kam zaya hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Regular repair and maintenance of water supply infrastructure minimize leaks and water loss

blocks.text: 33.8 Rules and Regulations regarding Waste Pollution and Conservation

blocks.prompt:
58 Name two Punjab laws related to water pollution and state the penalty under each.
(Water pollution se mutaliq Punjab ke do qawaneen ke naam aur har aik ki saza likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Punjab Environmental Protection Act, 1997: Rs 5 million tak jurmana aur roz ka Rs 100,000 tak.
Punjab Water Act, 2019: 3 maah tak qaid aur/ya Rs 500,000 jurmana.

book_ref.quote: The Government of Punjab has made several acts and laws to address the water pollution

blocks.prompt:
59 What is the scope of the Punjab Water and Sanitation Authority Act, 2025?
(Punjab Water and Sanitation Authority Act, 2025 ka daaira kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh bare shehron (Lahore, Multan waghera) mein mukammal resource management aur zer-e-zameen pani bachane ke liye Authority qaim karta hai.

book_ref.quote: for integrated resource management and groundwater conservation
